snippet.title: Desktop Explorer Release Date Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Desktop Explorer is showcasing with their first on-camera segment, highlighting never before seen footage from the game's second and third chapters and focusing on how gameplay evolves as the game progresses. New narrative details are revealed as we learn more about how Desktop Explorer torments the computer's previous users. Desktop Explorer is releasing on Steam on July 17, 2026!

Wishlist Desktop Explorer now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527160/Desktop_Explorer/
